maintain.en: To maintain acceptable prices and reliable supply, countries started to admit that being able to produce your own energy was extremely important.
maintain.zh: 为了维持可承受的价格和可靠的供应，各国开始承认，能够自主生产能源极其重要。

main.en: These are companies whose main business has nothing to do with electricity.
main.zh: 这些公司的主营业务与电力毫无关系。

main.en: Traditional British cooking relied on the flavor of the main ingredients.
main.zh: 传统的英国烹饪依赖于主要食材的风味。

main.en: Critics point out that decisions made about something as safety-critical as nuclear power are increasingly being made by companies whose main interest is keeping their data centres running, not public accountability .
main.zh: 批评人士指出，像核电这样攸关安全的重大决策，正日益由那些主要利益是维持数据中心运行、而非对公众负责的公司来制定。

mass.en: Britain became the pioneer of mass production, and this was applied to food as well.
mass.zh: 英国成为了大规模生产的先驱，这也应用到了食物上。

massive.en: Britain was the first country to have this massive urbanization.
massive.zh: 英国是第一个经历大规模城市化的国家。

major.en: And chicken tikka masala isn’t alone. The chicken balti, for example, was invented in Birmingham in the 1970s by Pakistani immigrants and is now a major part of Birmingham’s food culture.
major.zh: 而且鸡肉蒂卡玛莎拉并不孤单。例如，巴蒂鸡（chicken balti）是20世纪70年代由巴基斯坦移民在伯明翰发明的，现在是伯明翰饮食文化的重要组成部分。
